name: Eni SpA
tagline: Global energy company transitioning toward sustainable energy solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: La croissance de la production d'exploration et production de 9% en glissement annuel à 1,8 million boe/d reflète la stratégie d'accroissement organique et la découverte exceptionnelle de ressources (1 milliard boe) en 2026, un pilier de la création de valeur pour Eni.

kpis.explanation: Daily crude oil and natural gas production in millions of barrels of oil equivalent (BOE).
kpis.signal: Strong year-over-year production growth driven by organic exploration and development projects.
kpis.description: EP production reached 1.8 million barrels of oil equivalent per day in Q1 2026, reflecting successful execution of the organic growth strategy and major discoveries.

kpis.explanation: Total resources discovered through exploration activities in the reporting period.
kpis.signal: Exceptional exploration results with approximately 1 billion BOE discovered across Angola, Côte d'Ivoire, Libya,…
kpis.description: Year-to-date 2026 exploration has delivered outstanding results with 1 billion barrels of oil equivalent discovered, including major finds in Indonesia (Geliga) and other key jurisdictions.

kpis.explanation: Full year cash flow from operations guidance raised following strong Q1 performance.
kpis.signal: FY CFFO guidance raised by 20% to 13.8 billion EUR, reflecting strong operational performance and improved market…
kpis.description: Eni raised its full-year 2026 cash flow from operations guidance to 13.8 billion EUR, up 20% from previous guidance, supported by strong underlying performance.

kpis.explanation: Proposed share buyback authorization to return value to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Share buyback program increased by approximately 90% to 2.8 billion EUR, demonstrating confidence in execution and…
kpis.description: The proposed share buyback authorization was increased by approximately 90% to 2.8 billion EUR, reflecting Eni's strong cash generation and shareholder distribution policy.

kpis.explanation: New customer additions through Acea Energia acquisition, strengthening retail gas and power presence.
kpis.signal: Plenitude completed acquisition of Acea Energia, adding 1.2 million clients to its customer base in the transition…
kpis.description: The acquisition of Acea Energia by Plenitude added 1.2 million customers, strengthening Eni's position in retail gas and power services.

ai_positioning.summary: Aucune mention d'intelligence artificielle ou de fonctionnalités IA dans les documents fournis. Les initiatives stratégiques se concentrent sur l'exploration pétrolière, la transition énergétique et les énergies renouvelables.
evidence: Absence de références à l'IA dans les stratégies de production ou d'exploration.
Pas de KPIs liés à l'IA dans les segments commerciaux.
Focus stratégique sur la découverte de ressources naturelles et la transition énergétique, non sur l'IA.
